name: prime-gym
description: Monorepo desacoplado para gestión de gimnasio: API (Express+Prisma) + Frontend (React+Vite PWA) + Shared types

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=@gym/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@gym/frontend"
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist packages/*/dist
